description: This file defines a fixture class 'LDAPUsersFixture' used for setting up and tearing down LDAP directory structure and entries for testing purposes in the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin. It includes methods to create and delete organizational units, user entries, and groups, utilizing the Symfony LDAP component.

classes.name: LDAPUsersFixture
classes.description: Fixture class to setup and teardown LDAP directory entries for testing LDAP integration in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Creates LDAP organizational units, users, and groups for testing.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Deletes LDAP organizational units, users, and groups to clean up after tests.

methods.name: searchAndDelete
methods.description: Searches LDAP entries at a specified DN matching a query and deletes them.

methods.name: removeEntity
methods.description: Removes a specified LDAP entry.

methods.name: tryWrapper
methods.description: Executes a closure with exception handling for LDAP exceptions.

methods.name: createRootOrgUnits
methods.description: Creates the base 'dc=example,dc=org' LDAP root organizational units.

methods.name: deleteRootOrgUnits
methods.description: Removes the root organizational units and related entries.

methods.name: createAdminOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates LDAP organizational units and user entries for the admin group.

methods.name: deleteAdminOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes LDAP entries related to the admin organizational unit.

methods.name: createSalesOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates LDAP organizational units and user entries for the sales group.

methods.name: deleteSalesOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes LDAP entries related to the sales organizational unit.

methods.name: createLegalOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates LDAP organizational unit for legal department.

methods.name: deleteLegalOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes LDAP legal organizational unit.

methods.name: createEngineeringOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates LDAP organizational units and users for the engineering department, including developers, managers, and QA.

methods.name: deleteEngineeringOrgUnit
methods.description: Removes LDAP entries related to engineering department and its sub-units.

methods.name: createFinanceOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates LDAP organizational unit and user entries for finance.

methods.name: deleteFinanceOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes LDAP finance organizational unit and associated entries.

methods.name: createAdminsGroup
methods.description: Creates LDAP group for admins.

methods.name: deleteAdminsGroup
methods.description: Removes LDAP admin group.

methods.name: createManagersGroup
methods.description: Creates LDAP group for managers.

methods.name: deleteManagersGroup
methods.description: Removes LDAP managers group.

methods.name: createEmployeesGroup
methods.description: Creates LDAP group for employees in engineering.

methods.name: deleteEmployeesGroup
methods.description: Removes LDAP employees group.
